files.description: Daily weather at one station (90 rows, one per day in date order from 2025-06-01, no gaps): date (YYYY-MM-DD), temp_c (mean temperature in degrees C, two decimals; about 1% empty), humidity (percent, whole number).

task_text: The standard error of the mean of a window is the sample standard deviation of its values (dividing by n - 1) divided by the square root of n, the number of values in the window. For each day, take the 7-day window of temperatures (that day and the 6 days before it) and give the window mean and a band of the mean minus and plus 1.96 standard errors of the mean; leave all three empty when the window has fewer than 7 temperatures. `result` should be a table indexed by date with the columns mean, lower and upper.
intended_computation: For each day with 7 present values in the trailing 7-row window: mean, mean - 1.96 * sd/sqrt(7) and mean + 1.96 * sd/sqrt(7) (sd with n - 1); missing otherwise.

predicted_direction.reason: The band uses rolling().sem(), which was too wide on 2.x (sd / sqrt(n - 1)); 3.x uses sd / sqrt(n) as defined in the task.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row X01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
